verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent toolkit exposes a `get_merchant_insights` tool that retrieves business intelligence/analytics data (orders, sales, by time interval) for merchants, which an AI agent can use to generate insights and suggestions — but this is data access via the agent-toolkit/MCP layer for external AI agents rather than a native, in-product AI insights/suggestions feature surfaced directly to users inside PayPal's own dashboard. missing for 10: evidence of native in-app AI-generated insights/suggestions UI (e.g., a PayPal dashboard copilot), independent/hands-on confirmation of insight quality, and any use of suggestions beyond raw analytics retrieval.
